inline_text:
The template told authors to title the report PR `[Report] <WG name> – <Month YYYY>`. The TC reporting guidelines require `[Report] <YYYY-MM>` and the `monthly-report` label so that reports can be found automatically. The June and July report PRs followed the template and don't match.

- Step 3 now gives the required title format.
- Step 4 adds the `monthly-report` label.
- Step 1 notes that the file name is case-sensitive.
- The comment links to the guidelines: https://github.com/aaif/technical-committee/blob/main/working-groups/reporting.md
